ruleA: (a) lists the test_hand_* tests whose own code read the nominal / available strength or the utilisation (measured value of a limit check) of a check citing the item, plus the function-level entries of 'functionLevelA'; 'aDetail' lists hand tests that read only an intermediate value of such a check (not counted as (a)); a check the engine produced in a hand test without the test looking at it earns no credit
